## Shopwave Storefront Instructions

- Use Next.js App Router patterns for pages, route handlers, and server components.
- Keep auth and order logic server-side.
- Use Prisma for product, user, and order persistence.
- Prefer small, focused components for catalog, cart, checkout, and admin flows.
- Validate request payloads with Zod before writing to the database.
- Keep the UI responsive and consistent with the existing dark glassmorphism style.
